capabilities: Organize checkboxes into six fixed GTD views
Insert formatted task lines at the cursor
Group tasks by tags across the vault
Mark tasks done with in-place done dates
extras: Free and open-source; part of the author's Plus Plugin Family alongside Paste Plus, Vault Plus, Link Plus, Meetings Plus, and Assist Plus. Fully local with no network requests or telemetry. A 'What's new' window shows release notes once per device after updates and links to support the plugin. Works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Getting an organized task overview in Obsidian normally requires a query language, a database, or heavy configuration.

relations.evidence: If you've used Things, you know the feel.
compatible with the emoji format of the Tasks plugin

summary: GTD task manager that organizes plain-markdown checkboxes into six fixed views with natural-language quick capture and no database.
